evidence.quote: adopted a resolution initiating amendments to the existing Loudoun County

summary.short: Loudoun County, Virginia zoning amendments (ZOAM-2024-0001), adopted March 18, 2025, move data center use from by-right to special exception (SPEX) approval in the Industrial Park, General Industry and Mineral Resource-Heavy Industry districts. A grandfathering resolution covers applications accepted on or before February 12, 2025.
summary.long: The Loudoun County Board of Supervisors adopted the Phase 1 Zoning Ordinance text amendments (ZOAM-2024-0001) on March 18, 2025. They amend Table 3.02.05-1 so that data center use requires a special exception (SPEX) in the Industrial Park (IP), General Industry (GI) and Mineral Resource-Heavy Industry (MR-HI) districts, where it was previously permitted by-right. Table footnote 3 allows minor site plan changes for approved data center uses without SPEX, applying Section 10.11.01.H. Footnote 4 deems certain rezoning approvals made on or before March 18, 2025 that detail a specific data center use to include a SPEX approval. A companion Grandfathering Resolution lets legislative applications, and administrative applications for by-right data center uses, officially accepted on or before February 12, 2025 proceed without SPEX. Administrative applications must show that proposed structures and external mechanical equipment are more than 500 feet from existing residential structures. Grandfathered status is lost after a substantial modification, six months of non-response to project-manager requests, or, for administrative applications, failure to meet Zoning Ordinance and related standards within three years. The document also contains companion 2019 General Plan amendments (CPAM-2024-0001) to place-type text and maps, which this record does not code.

notes: The packet contains the Board action item with staff report, the 2019 General Plan redline excerpt (Attachment 1), the Zoning Ordinance Table 3.02.05-1 redline (Attachments 2 and 3), and two Grandfathering Resolution versions: Attachment 4 (clean) and Attachment 5 (redline against the March 4 draft). Annotated as the ZOAM; clean Attachment 4 is used as the operative resolution text. Clerk certification and signature blocks are blank, so adoption on March 18, 2025 rests on the certification wording and registry metadata. Internal inconsistency: the Motion 4 direction covers legislative applications approved after December 13, 2023, while footnote 4 to Table 3.02.05-1 covers approvals on or before March 18, 2025. Attachment 1 shows tracked-change residue ('seventeen ninety-one million square feet').

enforcement.note: The document contains no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocations, injunctions, suspensions or blocking provisions. Paragraphs 9 and 10 of the Grandfathering Rules state that an application loses its grandfathered status after a substantial modification or a failure to diligently pursue approval, and that the Project Manager gives written notice. These are coded as conditions of a transitional eligibility, not as sanctions. Violation and penalty provisions of the Zoning Ordinance are not in the fetched text.
